title: Diabetic wound healing breakthrough: theaflavin-3, 3'-digallate nanoparticles@hydrogel activates the TGF-beta1/SMAD3 pathway.
authors: Dong, Xu; Miao, Jianyin; Wu, Ling; Kong, Ziyu; Liu, Zenghui; Jia, Diyi; Zhai, Qingqing; Zhang, Dan; Xu, Yan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究茶黄素纳米颗粒水凝胶通过TGF-beta1/SMAD3通路促进糖尿病伤口愈合，分子对接仅用于验证小分子与蛋白亲和力，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diabetes patients face an elevated wound infection susceptibility and delayed healing processes. Currently, no existing literature has reported on the effect and mechanism of theaflavin-3, 3'-digallate nanoparticles (TFDG NPS) and TFDG NPS@hydrogels on diabetic wounds. PURPOSE: Given that the treatment options for diabetic wound are limited, the aim of this study is to develop an innovative therapeutic approach to address diabetic wounds. METHODS: The TFDG NPS were prepared using ionic cross-linking, and they were then characterized. The biocompatibility of the TFDG NPS and TFDG NPS@hydrogel was assessed using a Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) assay and live/dead staining on HK-2 cells in vitro. Diabetic ICR mice were induced through intraperitoneal injection of streptozocin (STZ). They were then subjected to the creation of two full-thickness wounds on their dorsal areas. The effect and mechanism of the TFDG NPS and TFDG NPS@hydrogel on wound healing in diabetic mice were evaluated using a histological analysis, a western blot analysis, and molecular docking. RESULTS: The optimal TFDG NPS proportion was found to be TFDG:Gelatin (Gel):Chitosan (CS) = 2:1:1. Images photographed using a transmission electron microscope (TEM) revealed that the TFDG NPS appeared spherical, with a diameter of approximately 140 +/- 20 nm. The favorable bio-compatibility of the TFDG NPS and TFDG NPS@hydrogel was confirmed using cell experiments. Animal studies demonstrated that both the TFDG NPS and TFDG NPS@hydrogel enhanced collagen fiber accumulation and new blood vessel density, reduced F4/80 infiltration, and upregulated the expression levels of TGF-beta1, SMAD3, Collagen I, and alpha-SMA. The potential mechanism may involve activation of the TGF-beta1/SMAD3 pathway, stimulating the secretion of Collagen I and alpha-SMA, and thereby facilitating wound closure in diabetic mice. The molecular docking results confirmed a high affinity between TFDG and TGF-beta1/SMAD3. CONCLUSION: TFDG NPS and TFDG NPS@hydrogel promoted wound closure in diabetic mice through the TFG-beta1/SMAD3 pathway, thus exhibiting promising therapeutic potential for diabetic wound treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病患者面临伤口感染易感性升高和愈合过程延迟的问题。目前，尚无文献报道茶黄素-3,3'-二没食子酸酯纳米颗粒（TFDG NPS）及TFDG NPS@水凝胶对糖尿病伤口的作用及机制。目的：鉴于糖尿病伤口的治疗选择有限，本研究旨在开发一种创新的治疗方法以应对糖尿病伤口。方法：采用离子交联法制备TFDG NPS，并对其进行表征。通过细胞计数试剂盒-8（CCK-8）检测和活/死染色在体外对HK-2细胞评估TFDG NPS和TFDG NPS@水凝胶的生物相容性。通过腹腔注射链脲佐菌素（STZ）诱导糖尿病ICR小鼠，随后在其背部制造两个全层伤口。通过组织学分析、蛋白质印迹分析和分子对接评估TFDG NPS和TFDG NPS@水凝胶对糖尿病小鼠伤口愈合的作用及机制。结果：最佳TFDG NPS比例为TFDG：明胶（Gel）：壳聚糖（CS）= 2:1:1。透射电子显微镜（TEM）拍摄的图像显示，TFDG NPS呈球形，直径约为140 ± 20 nm。细胞实验证实了TFDG NPS和TFDG NPS@水凝胶具有良好的生物相容性。动物研究表明，TFDG NPS和TFDG NPS@水凝胶均增强了胶原纤维积累和新血管密度，减少了F4/80浸润，并上调了TGF-beta1、SMAD3、Collagen I和alpha-SMA的表达水平。潜在机制可能涉及激活TGF-beta1/SMAD3通路，刺激Collagen I和alpha-SMA的分泌，从而促进糖尿病小鼠的伤口闭合。分子对接结果证实TFDG与TGF-beta1/SMAD3之间具有高亲和力。结论：TFDG NPS和TFDG NPS@水凝胶通过TFG-beta1/SMAD3通路促进糖尿病小鼠的伤口闭合，从而展现出治疗糖尿病伤口的 promising 治疗潜力。
